Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion and excited about the use cases you outlined for summarization + triage in clinical workflows. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

- Pilot scope: 6-week evaluation focused on inpatient discharge summaries and pre-auth triage.
- Current pilot credits: 150k tokens remaining (see attached burn-rate export).
- Ask from Acme: possible 2-week extension of free credits if we see steady usage.
- Data points we need from you to finalize the extension: 
  1) Expected average daily token volume for the next 2–4 weeks (rough ballpark is fine).
  2) Target unit economics / budget range you’re aiming for (e.g., $/1M tokens or monthly budget cap).
  3) Any procurement timelines that would affect a paid conversion (PO window, approval owner).

If you can reply with the above by EOD Monday, I’ll route the extension to our sales ops for approval and share a small addendum for signatures if needed. I attached the current burn-rate export so you can see how the credits are being consumed across endpoints.

Thanks — quick next step here is just numbers from your side and I’ll handle the approvals.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Marissa — good call. Quick answers below: 

1) Expected token volumes: we’re averaging ~180k tokens/day now across inference and batching is coming; anticipate 200–250k/day over the next 2 weeks as we ramp tests. For a full-week normal operation we’d be ~1.4–1.75M tokens/week.
2) Budget range / unit economics: leadership has allocated $15k–$25k for an initial paid evaluation if performance holds. For planning purposes they asked for an approximate $/1M-token number so they can compare (ballpark is fine). Can you provide what Redwood would estimate for $/1M tokens given our likely usage profile?
3) Procurement: procurement can sign a small PO within 3 weeks; decision maker is Priya (cc’d). No legal redlines expected for a small pilot SOW.

We’d like to request a 2-week extension of the free credits to avoid throttling while procurement moves. If you can push an approval through, we’ll keep pushing integration tests.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of AI Product | Acme Health

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the numbers; that ramp makes sense. Quick answers & next steps from our side: 

- Unit economics: based on your expected profile (200–250k tokens/day with some batching), the approximate list cost would be ~$1,000–$1,200 per 1M tokens for the model variants we discussed (gen-large with kv-cache and moderate quant). I included a short note below on levers to reduce cost (batching, prefix caching, lower-precision model variant).

- Credits extension: I’m looping in Rishi to approve a 2-week pilot credits extension of 200k tokens (one-time top-up) to cover the ramp period while procurement completes.

- Next step: If procurement confirms the PO timeline (3 weeks), we’ll prepare a short SOW and a quote at a scale breakpoint (monthly commit option that would bring $/1M closer to $700 if they commit to reserved capacity).

Levers to lower $/1M: 
  • Enable batching at inference layer (we estimate 10–20% token savings on throughput windows)
  • Prefix/KV caching for recurrent patient templates (substantial token reduction for repeated context)
  • Evaluate a 4-bit quantized model variant for lower-cost bulk scoring (quality tradeoff to validate)

Alex — if you’re good with the extension, I’ll ask Rishi to finalize approval and share the credits addendum PDF.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

I’ve authorized a one-time credit top-up of 200,000 tokens for Acme Health, valid for 21 days from today (2026-12-01). We’ll record this against deal ACME-2026-07 and flag for review if daily burn exceeds 300k tokens.

- If you want pricing locked for the PO route: offer a 3-month commit at $720 per 1M tokens (reserved capacity price) — otherwise list rate ~ $1,100 per 1M tokens as Marissa indicated.

Alex — let us know if you want me to route a quick quote for the commit option; happy to draft.
